import java.util.*;
public class sd {   
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // TODO Auto-generated method stub
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] h = new int[6];
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++){
            h[i] = in.nextInt();
        }
        int t=0,s=0;
        s = h[1] + h[2]-1;
        t = h[0] + h[3];
        int k = Math.min(h[0], h[3]);
        int p = 0,l=0;
        
            if(h[3]>=h[0]){
                for(int j=1;j<=Math.min(h[1], h[5]);j++){
                    t += 2*(k+j);
                    p = k+j;
                    s--;
                }
                for(int j=Math.min(h[1], h[5])+1;j<=Math.max(h[1], h[5]);j++){
                    t += 2*p;
                    s--;
                }
                
                while(s > 0){
                    p--;
                    t += 2*p;
                    s--;
                }
                
                
            }
            else{
                for(int j=1;j<=Math.min(h[2], h[4]);j++){
                    t += 2*(k+j);
                    p = k+j;
                    s--;
                    
                }
                for(int j=Math.min(h[2], h[4])+1;j<=Math.max(h[2], h[4]);j++){
                    t += 2*(p);
                    s--;
                }
                while(s > 0){
                    p--;
                    t += 2*p;
                    s--;
                }
                
            }
            System.out.println(t);
        
        
    }
    
    
}
